tools.name: screen_mark
tools.description:
Screen a brand name against the live trademark registers. Free, no account.

    Returns every mark near it with a similarity tier, plus which registers were
    checked. This is the first thing to run when someone asks 'is my name taken'.

tools.name: suggest_classes
tools.description:

tools.name: filing_landscape
tools.description:
Filing activity in a Nice class — volume by month and the busiest filers. Free.

    Answers "how crowded is my space" and "who keeps filing near me". Pass a Nice
    class (9, 42, 36…), optionally an office code ('EM', 'US', 'GB', 'CH'), and a
    window in months.

    EVERY COUNT IS OF OUR MIRROR
